Calculate Pressure and Flow Profile Along a Lateral Line (Backstep Procedure)

Source: R/calc_backstep.R
calc_backstep.Rd

Calculates the pressure head and flow rate profile along an irrigation lateral line, starting from the distal end (last emitter) and stepping backwards to the inlet using one of the head loss equations from the hf package: Darcy-Weisbach (hf::calc_head_loss_darcy()), Flamant (hf::calc_head_loss_flamant()), or Hazen-Williams (hf::calc_head_loss_hw()).

Usage

calc_backstep(
  end_pressure,
  diameter,
  spacing,
  n_emitters,
  slope = 0,
  emitter_coef,
  emitter_exp,
  method = c("darcy", "flamant", "hw"),
  flow_unit = "m3/s",
  ...
)

Arguments

end_pressure

Numeric. Pressure head at the end of the lateral line (last emitter) in meters of water column (mca).

diameter

Numeric. Internal pipe diameter in meters (m).

spacing

Numeric vector or single value. Emitter spacing in meters (m).

n_emitters

Integer. Total number of emitters on the lateral line (must be >= 2).

slope

Numeric. Elevation change (slope) per meter of pipe (m/m). Positive values indicate uphill slope, negative values indicate downhill slope. Defaults to 0.

emitter_coef

Numeric. Emitter discharge coefficient in units consistent with flow_unit (e.g., \(\text{m}^3\,\text{s}^{-1}\,\text{mca}^{-x}\) when flow_unit = "m3/s", or \(\text{L}\,\text{h}^{-1}\,\text{mca}^{-x}\) when flow_unit = "L/h").

emitter_exp

Numeric. Emitter discharge exponent (between 0 and 1).

method

Character. Head loss equation to use: "darcy" for Darcy-Weisbach (default), "flamant" for Flamant, or "hw" for Hazen-Williams.

flow_unit

Character. Unit of the volumetric flow rate used for emitter_coef and returned in emitter_flow and section_flow. Passed directly to the chosen hf head loss function. Options include "m3/s" (default), "m3/min", "m3/h", "m3/d", "L/s", "L/min", "L/h", and "L/d".

...

Additional arguments passed to the chosen head loss function:

  • For "darcy": roughness, friction_factor, friction_fun, viscosity, gravity (either roughness or friction_factor must be supplied).

  • For "flamant": coef (default 0.000135).

  • For "hw": coef (default 140).

Value

A tibble::tibble() containing the hydraulic profile of the lateral line:

  • emitter: Integer emitter index (1 is the first emitter near the inlet, n is the last).

  • pressure_head: Pressure head at each emitter (mca).

  • emitter_flow: Flow rate discharged by each emitter (in flow_unit).

  • section_flow: Flow rate in the pipe section immediately upstream of the emitter (in flow_unit).

  • head_loss: Friction head loss in the pipe section upstream of the emitter (m).

Examples

# 1. Darcy-Weisbach (default) with flow in m3/s
calc_backstep(
  end_pressure = 10,
  diameter = 0.012,
  spacing = 1,
  n_emitters = 5,
  slope = 0,
  emitter_coef = 8.84e-7,
  emitter_exp = 0.50,
  roughness = 1.5e-6
)
#> # A tibble: 5 × 5
#>   emitter pressure_head emitter_flow section_flow head_loss
#>     <int>         <dbl>        <dbl>        <dbl>     <dbl>
#> 1       1          10.0   0.00000280   0.0000140   0.00225 
#> 2       2          10.0   0.00000280   0.0000112   0.00169 
#> 3       3          10.0   0.00000280   0.00000839  0.00112 
#> 4       4          10.0   0.00000280   0.00000559  0.000562
#> 5       5          10     0.00000280   0.00000280  0       

# 2. Drip lateral line using Flamant and flow in L/h
calc_backstep(
  end_pressure = 10,
  diameter = 0.012,
  spacing = 0.3,
  n_emitters = 12,
  slope = 0,
  emitter_coef = 3.18,
  emitter_exp = 0.50,
  method = "flamant",
  flow_unit = "L/h",
  coef = 0.000135
)
#> # A tibble: 12 × 5
#>    emitter pressure_head emitter_flow section_flow head_loss
#>      <int>         <dbl>        <dbl>        <dbl>     <dbl>
#>  1       1          10.0         10.1        121.  0.00417  
#>  2       2          10.0         10.1        111.  0.00353  
#>  3       3          10.0         10.1        101.  0.00294  
#>  4       4          10.0         10.1         90.5 0.00239  
#>  5       5          10.0         10.1         80.5 0.00189  
#>  6       6          10.0         10.1         70.4 0.00144  
#>  7       7          10.0         10.1         60.3 0.00105  
#>  8       8          10.0         10.1         50.3 0.000710 
#>  9       9          10.0         10.1         40.2 0.000429 
#> 10      10          10.0         10.1         30.2 0.000211 
#> 11      11          10.0         10.1         20.1 0.0000628
#> 12      12          10           10.1         10.1 0        

# 3. Hazen-Williams with custom C coefficient and flow in L/s
calc_backstep(
  end_pressure = 15,
  diameter = 0.025,
  spacing = 6,
  n_emitters = 8,
  slope = 0.02,
  emitter_coef = 0.05,
  emitter_exp = 0.50,
  method = "hw",
  flow_unit = "L/s",
  coef = 150
)
#> # A tibble: 8 × 5
#>   emitter pressure_head emitter_flow section_flow head_loss
#>     <int>         <dbl>        <dbl>        <dbl>     <dbl>
#> 1       1          21.7        0.233        1.66     2.02  
#> 2       2          19.5        0.221        1.42     1.48  
#> 3       3          17.9        0.212        1.20     1.03  
#> 4       4          16.8        0.205        0.990    0.672 
#> 5       5          16.0        0.200        0.785    0.390 
#> 6       6          15.5        0.197        0.585    0.183 
#> 7       7          15.2        0.195        0.388    0.0503
#> 8       8          15          0.194        0.194    0
